subject: Payment run alignment & tiered discount structure for Blue Harbor
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueharbor.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Timothy Gray <timothy.gray@blueharbor.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood pilot

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs liked the latency numbers. Procurement is moving fast and we want to put a formal PO in place so finance can schedule the vendor setup. Before we generate the PO there are a few billing constraints from our side that I need to confirm: 

- Invoice cadence: Blue Harbor processes vendor invoices on the 15th and last day of each month. We prefer invoices dated such that the due date lines up with these runs (typical terms are Net30 or Net45). Can you confirm which net terms Redwood can support?
- PO/Cost-center split: We will need either separate invoices per internal cost center or a single consolidated invoice with a per-line cost-center code. Our AP system requires a PO number on every invoice.
- Preferred invoice format: CSV or PDF with a CSV attachment for automated ingestion.
- Remittance: please confirm if electronic remit to bank is supported and whether ACH details can be included on the invoice.
- Discounts: we have a standard process for applying committed-spend discounts via a standing PO. Please confirm any volume/commitment discounts and whether a standing PO can trigger a reduced unit price.

Also attached is our standard PO template (we would populate and send). Can you send a short note confirming Redwood's ability to: accept Net45, provide consolidated monthly invoices with a cost-center breakout, and apply a committed-spend discount if we do an annual standing PO? 

Appreciate a quick confirmation — procurement is targeting the 7th for vendor setup.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager
Blue Harbor Logistics

Attachment: BlueHarbor_PO_Template.pdf (1 page PDF)

From: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Timothy Gray <timothy.gray@blueharbor.com>, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood pilot

Hi Elena — great to hear procurement is moving this along. Short answers up front: yes on Net45 (we can accept Net30/Net45), and yes we can produce consolidated monthly invoices with per-line cost-center codes. I attached our quote for the pilot and a proposed pricing note reflecting a committed-spend discount for an annual standing PO.

A few operational notes / preferences from our side:
- Consolidated invoice: we typically issue one invoice per calendar month and can include a CSV attachment with line-level fields (cost_center, PO_number, sku, quantity, unit_price). That should meet your automated ingestion requirement.
- PO on invoice: please include the PO number(s) and cost-center codes. If Blue Harbor prefers separate invoices per cost center we can do that, but it will add manual processing time on our end (we can do it without extra fees).
- Net terms: we can accept Net45 for new customers; for customers who sign a 12-month committed PO we offer a tiered discount (see attached quote). The discount is applied to invoice line items once the standing PO is processed and referenced on invoices.
- Remit/ACH: we support ACH and wire; bank details are included on the invoice PDF.

Next steps: I can loop in Mina (finance) to finalize the operational acceptance details and provide a sample invoice layout. Once you confirm the discount trigger (annual commit amount and PO cadence) we'll prepare the DocuSign addendum.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-quote-2026-06-30.xlsx (pricing workbook)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood pilot (finance details)

Hi team — looping in the details Elena asked about. Finance confirms:

- Net45 acceptance: We can accept Net45 for this engagement. For accounting we will record invoice_date + 45 days as the due date.
- Invoice timing: To align with Blue Harbor's 15th/Month-end runs, we recommend issuing invoices on the 1st of each month (invoice covers prior calendar month usage). That gives Blue Harbor time to include the invoice in the 15th/30th runs depending on their internal lead times. If they need mid-month billing we can support a 1st and 16th issuance cadence.
- Consolidated vs split invoices: We can provide a single consolidated invoice with a CSV attachment containing per-line cost_center and PO_number fields. This is our preferred approach as it preserves a single payment obligation while satisfying their ingestion requirements. If procurement insists on separate invoices per cost center we can produce them — turnaround is 1-2 business days and we'll include the PO number on each.
- Discount application: The committed-spend discount can be applied at invoice generation once the standing PO is validated in our system. We require the PO to reference the Redwood deal id (BH-2026-07-001) for automatic pricing tiering.

I'll also attach a sample invoice (PDF) and a sample CSV layout for their AP team to validate.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Sample-invoice-with-CSV-layout.pdf (sample layout)

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueharbor.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Timothy Gray <timothy.gray@blueharbor.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood pilot

Thanks Soojin and Mina — that setup sounds workable. A couple quick clarifications so we can finish the PO: 

1) Discount: Confirming we want the committed-spend discount. Can you confirm the threshold and rate? We are targeting an initial standing PO for $250,000 for 12 months across three business units.
2) Invoice cadence: We'll accept a single consolidated invoice monthly, provided each invoice line contains the cost-center code and PO reference. Please send the sample CSV layout so our AP can validate ingestion.
3) DocuSign: we'll need a short addendum in DocuSign that references the standing PO and the discount structure.

If you can confirm 1) the discount % for $250k annual commit and 2) provide the sample CSV and the DocuSign link, procurement will generate the standing PO and aim to have it to you by 7/9.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: none

From: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood pilot — confirmation and next steps

Hi Elena — thanks, and glad to hear timelines are aligning. 

Confirmed items:
- Discount: For a 12-month standing PO >= $200,000 we apply a 5% committed-spend discount on usage line items. Your proposed $250k commit qualifies for the 5% tier.
- Invoice cadence: Redwood will issue a consolidated monthly invoice on the 1st of each month with a CSV attachment containing: date, invoice_number, line_item_description, sku, quantity, unit_price, extended_price, cost_center_code, PO_number. Sample CSV attached.
- Net terms: Net45 (invoice_date + 45 days). Please ensure the PO references deal id BH-2026-07-001 so discount application is automatic in our billing system.
- DocuSign: Here is the signing link for the short addendum that ties the standing PO to the committed-spend discount: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/BH-2026-07-001. We'll generate the first invoice after the standing PO is processed in our system.

Action items:
- Elena / Procurement: Send standing PO referencing BH-2026-07-001 and cost-center breakdown by 2026-07-09 if possible. Include billing contact for remittance.
- Soojin / Redwood: Once PO is received we will: 1) validate PO in billing, 2) send DocuSign for signature (if not already), 3) confirm first invoice date.

Attachments: Sample-CSV-layout.csv, Redwood-quote-2026-06-30.xlsx, BlueHarbor_PO_Template.pdf

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Sample-CSV-layout.csv (CSV), Redwood-quote-2026-06-30.xlsx (pricing workbook), BlueHarbor_PO_Template.pdf (PO template)
